fusions.name: Arbalest Bolt
fusions.desc: Looses a heavy bolt that deals 32 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 9 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Racked Quarrels
fusions.desc: Looses 3 quarrels at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Planted Pavise
fusions.desc: Plants a standing shield 4 tiles wide for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Bodkin Points
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 18% of the target's armour.
